title: Headers Chai-1 can read
story: Chai-1 needs every FASTA header to say what kind of molecule it is and give it a name, like `>protein|name=binder`. {{seq.0}}.fasta has a plain header. Change it to the Chai-1 style, naming the protein {{seq.0}}.

lesson.title: A Chai-1 FASTA header

parts.note: Starts a header line, as in any FASTA file.
The kind of molecule: protein, ligand, dna, rna or glycan.
A separator between the two parts.
The name Chai-1 uses for this chain in its output.

lesson.why: Chai-1 folds mixtures of molecules, so it can't guess what a sequence is. For a ligand, the line under the header is a SMILES string instead of a sequence.
lesson.without: A plain header like `>{{seq.0}}` stops Chai-1 with "Could not parse FASTA header".

hints: Change only the first line. The sequence stays as it is.
The first line should read `>protein|name={{seq.0}}`. Save with Ctrl+O, then Enter.
